tools.name: workplan_create
tools.description: Create a structured workplan under .opencode/workplan as a JSON document plus a linked Markdown plan. With overwrite=true, pass expectedHash = the stateHash from your latest read or successful write.

id.description: Workplan id; normalised to lowercase kebab-case for the filename

kind.description: Plan kind, such as feature, bugfix or research

planFile.description: Linked Markdown path under .opencode/workplan/; defaults to <id>.md

planMarkdown.description: Full Markdown body; generated from the JSON when omitted

specFiles.description: Workspace-relative spec files the plan depends on

id.description: Stable phase id; a readable id is generated when omitted
Stable step id; a readable id is generated when omitted

target.description: File, module or artifact the step touches

action.description: What to do in this step

validation.description: How to verify the step is done

source.description: Where the finding came from, such as file:line or a reviewer

overwrite.description: Replace an existing plan with the same id (requires expectedHash)

expectedHash.description: The stateHash last read for this plan; the write is refused if the plan changed since

replaceMarkdown.description: Allow replacing handwritten Markdown on overwrite

tools.name: workplan_update
tools.description: Update workplan metadata, the linked plan file, spec files, findings, dependencies, or targeted phase and step fields without rewriting the whole plan. Pass expectedHash = the stateHash from your latest read or successful write.

id.description: Workplan id; normalised to lowercase kebab-case for the filename

expectedHash.description: The stateHash last read for this plan; the write is refused if the plan changed since

rebase.description: Apply this write even if expectedHash is stale, when the plan's change log shows that every newer write changed other plan elements (other steps, phases, findings, or note appends). The newer changes are kept and the result names the writes rebased over. Refused as stale when a newer write touched an element this write changes, or when the log does not connect the two hashes

recovery.description: Finish (resume) or undo (rollback) an interrupted transaction; exclusive with other fields

replaceMarkdown.description: Allow a full regeneration or replacement of handwritten Markdown

status.description: New overall status; use workplan_reset to return to draft

planFile.description: Move the linked Markdown to this path under .opencode/workplan/

planMarkdown.description: Replace the linked Markdown with this text

source.description: Where the finding came from, such as file:line or a reviewer

id.description: Stable phase id; a readable id is generated when omitted
Stable step id; a readable id is generated when omitted

target.description: File, module or artifact the step touches

action.description: What to do in this step

validation.description: How to verify the step is done

phaseId.description: Id of the phase to change

afterPhaseId.description: Insert after this phase id; append when omitted

id.description: Stable phase id; a readable id is generated when omitted
Stable step id; a readable id is generated when omitted

target.description: File, module or artifact the step touches

action.description: What to do in this step

validation.description: How to verify the step is done

phaseId.description: Id of the phase holding the step

stepId.description: Id of the step to change

phaseId.description: Phase that receives the new step

afterStepId.description: Insert after this step id; append when omitted

id.description: Stable step id; a readable id is generated when omitted

target.description: File, module or artifact the step touches

action.description: What to do in this step

validation.description: How to verify the step is done

source.description: Where the finding came from, such as file:line or a reviewer

dependencies.description: Replace the whole step dependency sidecar; omit to leave it unchanged

recordEvidence.description: Append evidence for steps: the command you ran, its exit code and its output (only a sha256 is kept). Shiori binds it to the current git working tree; inspect/resume/doctor show whether it is still fresh. With only id, expectedHash and recordEvidence the plan and its hashes stay unchanged

output.description: Its output (hashed, not stored); or pass outputDigest

scope.description: Project-relative paths this evidence covers; it goes stale only when they change (default: the whole project outside .opencode/workplan)

lane.description: Active lane whose checkout the command ran in

lanes.description: Worktree lanes, applied in order: propose a lane for steps with path claims (overlapping claims are refused), move it claimed → prepared (record its worktree checkout) → running → review → integrating → merged (or abandoned), or change its claims. Shiori records and checks lanes; it never creates, merges or removes worktrees. With only id, expectedHash, lanes and recordEvidence the plan and its hashes stay unchanged

claims.description: propose: project-relative paths the lane owns (everything under each)

checkout.description: transition to prepared: the lane's worktree of this repository, outside the project root

planLinks.description: Links from this plan to other plans in the same root, replacing the stored list: blocks (the other plan waits for this one), blockedBy (this plan waits for the other) or related. Plans that do not exist yet are kept with a warning. Shown in doctor's portfolio and, while an unfinished plan blocks this one, in resume. With only id, expectedHash and sidecar members the plan and its hashes stay unchanged

tools.name: workplan_inspect
tools.description: List a workplan's stable phase and step ids and Markdown markers without returning the Markdown content.

id.description: Workplan id; normalised to lowercase kebab-case for the filename

tools.name: workplan_validate
tools.description: Validate a workplan's JSON, linked Markdown and spec files before handing it to other agents. Read-only.

id.description: Workplan id; normalised to lowercase kebab-case for the filename

tools.name: workplan_read
tools.description: Read one workplan, optionally filtered to a phase or step, with its linked Markdown.

id.description: Workplan id; normalised to lowercase kebab-case for the filename

includeMarkdown.description: Include the linked Markdown content; defaults to true

includeNotes.description: With phaseId/stepId: also return reviewFindings and notes (default false). A filtered read returns the plan header, hashes and the selected phase/step; linked Markdown only with includeMarkdown=true. Without a filter, false leaves the notes out of the whole document (often most of a long plan)

tools.name: workplan_list
tools.description: List the workplans stored in .opencode/workplan with their validity and hashes.

tools.name: workplan_patch
tools.description: Patch only the linked Markdown plan with a restricted single Update File patch; use workplan_update for JSON changes. Pass expectedHash = the stateHash from your latest read or successful write.

id.description: Workplan id; normalised to lowercase kebab-case for the filename

patchText.description: Restricted patch with exactly one Update File section for the linked Markdown

expectedHash.description: The stateHash last read for this plan; the write is refused if the plan changed since

tools.name: workplan_reset
tools.description: Reset a workplan: draft resets every status (plan, phases, steps) to draft and removes the checkpoint, keeping phases, steps, notes, findings and dependencies; wipe clears phases, findings and notes after a preview and an exact confirmation, archiving the originals first; markdown-only only regenerates the linked Markdown from the JSON. Pass expectedHash = the stateHash from your latest read or successful write.

id.description: Workplan id; normalised to lowercase kebab-case for the filename

mode.description: draft resets statuses only and keeps the plan content; wipe clears phases, findings and (unless preserveNotes) notes: call it first without previewToken/confirmation for a read-only preview, then again with that previewToken and confirmation=WIPE_PLAN_CONTENT; markdown-only only regenerates the Markdown

preserveNotes.description: Keep notes during a wipe (a draft reset always keeps notes)

expectedHash.description: The stateHash last read for this plan; the write is refused if the plan changed since

previewToken.description: mode=wipe only: the previewToken returned by the wipe preview

confirmation.description: mode=wipe only: must be WIPE_PLAN_CONTENT to apply the previewed wipe

tools.name: workplan_resume
tools.description: Return a compact continuation packet for an existing workplan: checkpoint, active steps, unresolved findings, and current guardrails, without dumping historical notes or completed phase details.

id.description: Workplan id; normalised to lowercase kebab-case for the filename

tools.name: workplan_checkpoint
tools.description: Write a concise, structured handoff checkpoint for the next session without replacing the full workplan. Include the current task, immediate next action, blockers, validation, and safety guardrails. Without merge=true it replaces the whole checkpoint (omitted fields become empty); to update it, pass merge=true (omitted fields keep their stored values) or read the current checkpoint first. Pass expectedHash = the stateHash from your latest read or successful write.

id.description: Workplan id; normalised to lowercase kebab-case for the filename

summary.description: Concise summary of the current state (required unless merge=true; never copy a null/withheld value from workplan_resume)

nextAction.description: The immediate next action for the next session (required unless merge=true)

guardrails.description: Safety guardrails to keep in mind

expectedHash.description: The stateHash last read for this plan; the write is refused if the plan changed since

merge.description: Keep the stored checkpoint's value of every omitted field (summary, nextAction, phase/step, blockers, recentValidation, guardrails, references); given fields replace theirs

appendValidation.description: Validation line(s) appended to recentValidation (exact duplicates skipped); use with merge=true to add evidence without rewriting the checkpoint

tools.name: workplan_compact
tools.description: Preview or archive explicitly selected workplan history. Apply mode requires a fresh checkpoint and exact confirmation; it snapshots the original JSON, linked Markdown, and checkpoint before removing only selected completed phases, notes, and explicitly resolved findings. In apply mode, pass expectedHash = the stateHash from your latest read or successful write.

id.description: Workplan id; normalised to lowercase kebab-case for the filename

mode.description: preview first, then apply with the preview token

archiveReason.description: Why this history is being archived

resolvedFindingIndexes.description: Zero-based indexes of resolved findings to archive

noteRollover.description: Instead of noteIndexes: archive every note older than the latest keepLatest (default 20) except pinned ones: [pinned] in the text or pinNoteIndexes, decision records (decision/decided or USER), notes naming an open step as phaseId/stepId or quoting an open finding title, and the latest 3 compaction archive pointers (older ones roll over). Apply needs a fresh checkpoint; pass the same noteRollover to preview and apply

keepLatest.description: Number of newest notes that always stay (default 20)

pinNoteIndexes.description: Zero-based indexes of further notes to keep

expectedHash.description: The stateHash last read for this plan; the write is refused if the plan changed since

tools.name: workplan_doctor
tools.description: Read-only diagnosis of workplan artifacts, hashes, sidecars, locks, and injected runtime facts.

id.description: Workplan id; normalised to lowercase kebab-case for the filename

limit.description: Maximum plans to diagnose; defaults to 50

tools.name: workplan_compact_preview
tools.description: Read-only preview of the exact workplan history selection and archive intent; this tool never applies compaction.

id.description: Workplan id; normalised to lowercase kebab-case for the filename

archiveReason.description: Why this history is being archived

resolvedFindingIndexes.description: Zero-based indexes of resolved findings to archive

noteRollover.description: Instead of noteIndexes: archive every note older than the latest keepLatest (default 20) except pinned ones: [pinned] in the text or pinNoteIndexes, decision records (decision/decided or USER), notes naming an open step as phaseId/stepId or quoting an open finding title, and the latest 3 compaction archive pointers (older ones roll over). Apply needs a fresh checkpoint; pass the same noteRollover to preview and apply

keepLatest.description: Number of newest notes that always stay (default 20)

pinNoteIndexes.description: Zero-based indexes of further notes to keep

expectedHash.description: The stateHash last read for this plan; the write is refused if the plan changed since
